name: web-agent-fixture
description: Comparable browser-agent tasks against the deterministic Weles benchmark fixture.

cases.title: Extract deterministic static content
cases.instruction: Open the page. Return its main heading as heading, every list item as items, and the main element's data-checksum attribute as checksum.
cases.justification: Measure extraction on the operator-controlled Weles benchmark fixture.

cases.title: Follow a link to a canonical record
cases.instruction: Open the page, follow the canonical record link, then return the destination record identifier as recordId and its output value as value.
cases.justification: Measure navigation on the operator-controlled Weles benchmark fixture.

cases.title: Submit a deterministic local form
cases.instruction: Open the page, enter the requested input value in the benchmark field, submit the form, then return submitted as a boolean and the displayed submitted value as value.
cases.justification: Measure a reversible form interaction on the operator-controlled Weles benchmark fixture.

cases.title: Wait for delayed client-side rendering
cases.instruction: Open the page, wait until the dynamic output stops saying pending, then return its final text as message.
cases.justification: Measure dynamic rendering on the operator-controlled Weles benchmark fixture.

cases.title: Scan a deterministic 100-row table
cases.instruction: Open the page. Count all body rows as rowCount and sum their numeric index cells as indexChecksum. Return both numbers.
cases.justification: Measure structured extraction on the operator-controlled Weles benchmark fixture.
